coverage_notes: All supplied observation anchors on PDF pages 1-4 were visually inspected. Matching is scoped to the supplied registry and CSV; no additional outcomes were registered. Poppler emitted missing-font warnings, but the viewed pages and labels were readable.
shared_qualifications: C1: Conditional hydrogen-scale to SCE comparison: E(mV vs SCE) = 1000 E(V on H2 scale) - 241, using the saturated-KCl SCE value +0.241 V vs NHE at 25 C from Corrtest https://www.corrtestinstruments.com/en/02437.html . This assumes the plotted H2 scale is the standard hydrogen scale and the target SCE reference is at 25 C; the paper does not specify the reference-electrode filling solution or temperature. Experimental 0 C is not assumed to be reference temperature; comparisons for 0 C experiments remain conditional. The offset is not fitted to CSV values.

obs_028 and obs_033 share CRA 333 as possibly repeated presentations of the low-Ni/Mo-free condition; neither independent runs nor exact repeated-run identity is established. Graphical composition coordinates differ slightly from nominal labels.

Paper p.2 distinguishes non-steady Vc-prime from long-hold steady Vc; unmatched Vc-prime observations are retained. obs_039 primary text 0.78 V conflicts with its approximately 0.80 V registered plot reading; both are preserved.
